did: Finished the Studio takes conveyor. Takes can now be sorted on their own page in the phone app, and only a take you mark ready for pickup is filed as a pending issue by the daily routine, which then marks it picked up. Your labels go along with the take; your note and the audio stay home, as you decided. The mailbox learned the two new folders and is deployed. Three CONVEYOR stories are closed. Reviews along the way caught that the routine could never answer a take already filed, and that a double tap on the page could land on the wrong button; both are fixed.

calls.title: Where a take ready for pickup is filed
options: paulgsc/some-ui, your labels as words in the issue
where the take's ref points, your labels as GitHub labels
calls.why: A take names a Studio shot, not a repository, and GitHub labels made from what you type would add a label per word.
calls.undo: pending.ts' pickup branch and part E's pickup bullet in topik ROUTINE.md

calls.title: Land the pickup before home can withdraw one
options: land now; you close a stray issue if a take left ready before the run
have home withdraw a pickup first
calls.why: For up to a day after you move a take off ready for pickup, the routine can still file it; under your standing 'go with the recommended'. #2973 is the fix.
